Arcmira SDK for YouTube transcript search, timestamped quotes, and company monitoring. Create an ArcmiraClient with your API key to call the API.
./channels: Check a YouTube channel's transcript coverage and access its indexed videos and sponsors. Channel reads take a YouTube channel id, not a name or handle.
./channels/sponsors: List the sponsors identified in a YouTube channel's indexed videos. Use channels.sponsors.list with a YouTube channel id.
./channels/videos: Page through a channel's indexed videos. Use channels.videos.list with a YouTube channel id and stop iterating when you have enough results.
./entities: Resolve a person, company, product, or show name to an id before filtering reads. Handle best, suggested, and ask results explicitly. Also read entity details and mention momentum.
./feedback: Submit a correction or report an API issue, then retrieve its status with the returned feedback id.
./health: Check API availability with health.check before diagnosing a failed integration.
./integrations: Discover account integrations available for monitor delivery. Slack connections are configured in the dashboard.
./integrations/slack: List connected Slack workspaces and channels before configuring a monitor's Slack destination.
./me: Read the account, plan, scopes, and role associated with the current API key, or update account settings.
./mentions: Find where an entity was mentioned in indexed media or count occurrences across channels and videos. Resolve names to entity ids first; dated reads use an inclusive after and exclusive before.
./monitors: Create and manage monitors that group tracked names and set alert delivery. Creating a monitor changes account state. Delivered alerts use credits from your plan, then your on-demand budget.
./monitors/alerts: Read a monitor's recent alerts. The result is one page; inspect the response before deciding whether you need a larger limit.
./monitors/entities: Follow indexed entities or exact names in a monitor. Inspect each attached result and its reason; an existing tracker may belong to another monitor.
./monitors/trackers: List a monitor's trackers or attach existing trackers by id. Attaching changes which monitor delivers their alerts.
./recommendations: Find on-air recommendations for an entity and distinguish organic recommendations from sponsored mentions. Resolve the entity name first and retain the verbatim quote and source.
./trackers: List, update, or remove followed names. Create trackers through monitors.entities.add so each tracker has a monitor for delivery.
./trackers/alerts: Read recent alerts for one tracker. Retain the source media and timestamps when presenting results.
./transcripts: Pull YouTube transcripts or search indexed spoken passages with timestamps and source links. A default read returns captions. Quote Premium credits before reading with quality premium; handle ready, pending, and failed states.
